basic_info.description: Sunset tunnel entrance FIXER. Located in the heart of the Sunset District, the home offers endless potential for investors, flippers or homeowners looking to bring their vision to life. This classic 1940s-era Tunnel Entry 2-bed, 1-bath home retains its charming character, featuring original parquet hardwood floors, vintage lighting, a cozy breakfast nook, and a full bathroom with a separate tub and shower stall configuration.The real opportunity lies downstairs-an expansive space with excellent ceiling height, providing a blank canvas for expansion, or reimagined layout to maximize value. Currently, the home includes a spacious garage, laundry area, and a low maintenance backyard perfect for outdoor entertainment or a play spece. Situated just minutes from top-rated schools, playgrounds, popular eatries, public transportation, shops, and laid-back, suburban-like community feel.
